title: RequestProject
description: plinth.request_project/1, from api.request_project(p_name, p_rera, p_whatsapp_consent) (API_CONTRACTS §3.2; DESIGN §5b Request a project; built by T45a). The record of the request: reference R-MMDD-NN (IST date), added by due_on (requested + 14 days) or told why not. p_whatsapp_consent is the buyer's own tap asking to hear back on WhatsApp too; it needs a linked, opted-in WhatsApp contact (otherwise consent_required). The same open request again returns the same reference.

name.description: The project as the buyer typed it.

line.description: "We'll add it by 1 Nov 2026 or tell you why not."

whatsapp_line.description: Set when the buyer asked to hear back on WhatsApp too.
